Boeing Cleared To Sell Parts & Jets To Belarus Despite Fears They’ll End Up In Russia
items.summary: Boeing has officially been cleared to resume direct business with Belarusian flag carrier Belavia, which flies 12 aircraft from the US planemaker. The airline had been placed under sanctions by the US, but these were initially eased back in September of 2025. Now the US has gone a step further after its Commerce Department licensed Boeing to deal directly with Belavia in terms of both parts and planes.

items.title: FAA Deploys First Digital Air Traffic Control Towers in Florida and Alaska, Equipping Controllers With Better Technology
items.summary: WASHINGTON, D.C. – The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) today announced that the nation's first digital towers are operational at airports in Florida and Alaska. The new technology gives air traffic controllers better tools to do their jobs by providing greater visibility of airport activity to help them monitor traffic. Controllers are still managing the airspace but now have modern technology and facilities.
